title: The Wolf and the Lion
summary: A wolf dragged a slaughtered lamb from the fold and was hauling it into his mountain lair when a lion leaped out, struck him down, and snatched the carcass between his jaws....
full_text:
A wolf dragged a slaughtered lamb from the fold and was hauling it into his mountain lair when a lion leaped out, struck him down, and snatched the carcass between his jaws.

Standing at a safe distance, the indignant wolf whined: "You have robbed me unjustly of my property!"

The lion chuckled: "Your property? Did the shepherd give it to you as a gift of love, or did you steal it from the fold under cover of darkness?"
moral: A thief has no right to cry robbery when a mightier thief takes his plunder.
